Shall not the Judge of all the earth deal justly?” ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Genesis 18:25", "heRef": "בראשית י״ח:כ״ה", "url": "Genesis.18.25"}, "Psalms.8.6": {"he": "וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃", "en": "that You have made them little less than divine,ddivine Or “the angels.” and adorned them with glory and majesty?", "lang": "en", "ref": "Psalms 8:6", "heRef": "תהילים ח׳:ו׳", "url": "Psalms.8.6"}, "Psalms.148.7": {"he": "הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ תַּ֝נִּינִ֗ים וְכׇל־תְּהֹמֽוֹת׃", "en": "Praise GOD, O you who are on earth,all sea monsters and ocean depths,", "lang": "en", "ref": "Psalms 148:7", "heRef": "תהילים קמ״ח:ז׳", "url": "Psalms.148.7"}, "Psalms.27.1": {"he": "לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהֹוָ֥ה מָעוֹז־חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃", "en": "Of David. GOD is my light and my help;whom should I fear? GOD is the stronghold of my life,whom should I dread?", "lang": "en", "ref": "Psalms 27:1", "heRef": "תהילים כ״ז:א׳", "url": "Psalms.27.1"}, "Deuteronomy.5.28": {"he": "וְאַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִי֒ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃", "en": "But you remain here with Me, and I will give you the whole Instruction—the laws and the rules—that you shall impart to them, for them to observe in the land that I am giving them to possess.”", "lang": "en", "ref": "Deuteronomy 5:28", "heRef": "דברים ה׳:כ״ח", "url": "Deuteronomy.5.28"}, "Genesis.49.6": {"he": "בְּסֹדָם֙ אַל־תָּבֹ֣א נַפְשִׁ֔י בִּקְהָלָ֖ם אַל־תֵּחַ֣ד כְּבֹדִ֑י כִּ֤י בְאַפָּם֙ הָ֣רְגוּ אִ֔ישׁ וּבִרְצֹנָ֖ם עִקְּרוּ־שֽׁוֹר׃", "en": "Let not my person be included in their council,Let not my being be counted in their assembly.For when angry they slay a man,aa man Or “a rival,” or “men.” And when pleased they maim an ox.bmaim an ox Or “overthrow a dignitary” (cf. chapter 34); or “maim oxen.” ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Genesis 49:6", "heRef": "בראשית מ״ט:ו׳", "url": "Genesis.49.6"}, "Isaiah.6.7": {"he": "וַיַּגַּ֣ע עַל־פִּ֔י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה נָגַ֥ע זֶ֖ה עַל־שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ וְסָ֣ר עֲוֺנֶ֔ךָ וְחַטָּאתְךָ֖ תְּכֻפָּֽר׃", "en": "touched it to my lips, and declared,“Now that this has touched your lips,Your guilt shall departAnd your sin be purged away.”", "lang": "en", "ref": "Isaiah 6:7", "heRef": "ישעיהו ו׳:ז׳", "url": "Isaiah.6.7"}, "Numbers.14.23": {"he": "אִם־יִרְאוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֑ם וְכׇל־מְנַאֲצַ֖י לֹ֥א יִרְאֽוּהָ׃", "en": "shall see the land that I promised on oath to their fathers;efathers See note at Exod. 13.5. none of those who spurn Me shall see it. ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Numbers 14:23", "heRef": "במדבר י״ד:כ״ג", "url": "Numbers.14.23"}, "Deuteronomy.8.7-8": {"he": "כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר׃ אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ־זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּדְבָֽשׁ׃", "en": "For the ETERNAL your God is bringing you into a good land, a land with streams and springs and fountains issuing from plain and hill;  a land of wheat and barley, of vines, figs, and pomegranates, a land of olive trees and honey; ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Deuteronomy 8:7-8", "heRef": "דברים ח׳:ז׳-ח׳", "url": "Deuteronomy.8.7-8"}, "Exodus.18.23": {"he": "אִ֣ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְצִוְּךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְיָֽכׇלְתָּ֖ עֲמֹ֑ד וְגַם֙ כׇּל־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־מְקֹמ֖וֹ יָבֹ֥א בְשָׁלֽוֹם׃", "en": "If you do this—and God so commands you—you will be able to bear up; and all these people too will go home unwearied.”", "lang": "en", "ref": "Exodus 18:23", "heRef": "שמות י״ח:כ״ג", "url": "Exodus.18.23"}, "Numbers.16.3": {"he": "וַיִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ עַל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְעַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶם֮ רַב־לָכֶם֒ כִּ֤י כׇל־הָֽעֵדָה֙ כֻּלָּ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים וּבְתוֹכָ֖ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמַדּ֥וּעַ תִּֽתְנַשְּׂא֖וּ עַל־קְהַ֥ל יְהֹוָֽה׃", "en": "They combined against Moses and Aaron and said to them, “You have gone too far! For all the community are holy, all of them, and GOD is in their midst. Why then do you raise yourselves above GOD’s congregation?”", "lang": "en", "ref": "Numbers 16:3", "heRef": "במדבר ט״ז:ג׳", "url": "Numbers.16.3"}, "Numbers.14.13": {"he": "וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְשָׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּֽי־הֶעֱלִ֧יתָ בְכֹחֲךָ֛ אֶת־הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה מִקִּרְבּֽוֹ׃", "en": "But Moses said to GOD, “When the Egyptians, from whose midst You brought up this people in Your might, hear the news, ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Numbers 14:13", "heRef": "במדבר י״ד:י״ג", "url": "Numbers.14.13"}, "Deuteronomy.8.9": {"he": "אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל־בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא־תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃", "en": "a land where you may eat food without stint, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and from whose hills you can mine copper. ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Deuteronomy 8:9", "heRef": "דברים ח׳:ט׳", "url": "Deuteronomy.8.9"}, "Deuteronomy.8.12": {"he": "פֶּן־תֹּאכַ֖ל וְשָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּבָתִּ֥ים טֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְיָשָֽׁבְתָּ׃", "en": "When you have eaten your fill, and have built fine houses to live in, ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Deuteronomy 8:12", "heRef": "דברים ח׳:י״ב", "url": "Deuteronomy.8.12"}, "Deuteronomy.8.1": {"he": "כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃", "en": "You shall faithfully observe all the Instruction that I enjoin upon you today, that you may thrive and increase and be able to possess the land that GOD promised on oath to your fathers.afathers See note at 1.35. ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Deuteronomy 8:1", "heRef": "דברים ח׳:א׳", "url": "Deuteronomy.8.1"}, "Deuteronomy.8.11": {"he": "הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃", "en": "Take care lest you forget the ETERNAL your God and fail to keep the commandments, rules, and laws that I enjoin upon you today. ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Deuteronomy 8:11", "heRef": "דברים ח׳:י״א", "url": "Deuteronomy.8.11"}, "Exodus.32.31-32": {"he": "וַיָּ֧שׇׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אָ֣נָּ֗א חָטָ֞א הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃ וְעַתָּ֖ה אִם־תִּשָּׂ֣א חַטָּאתָ֑ם וְאִם־אַ֕יִן מְחֵ֣נִי נָ֔א מִֽסִּפְרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתָֽבְתָּ׃", "en": "Moses went back to GOD and said, “Alas, this people is guilty of a great sin in making for themselves a god of gold.  Now, if You will forgive their sin [well and good]; but if not, erase me from the record that You have written!” ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Exodus 32:31-32", "heRef": "שמות ל״ב:ל״א-ל״ב", "url": "Exodus.32.31-32"}, "Targum_Jonathan_on_Numbers.12.3": {"he": "וְגַבְרָא משֶׁה עִנְוְותָן בְּדַעֲתֵּיהּ לַחֲדָא מִן כָּל בְּנֵי נְשָׁא דְעַל אַנְפֵּי אַרְעָא וְלָא חָשׁ לְמִלֵיהוֹן", "en": " But the man Mosheh was more bowed down in his mind than all the children of men upon the face of the earth; neither cared he for their words.\n", "lang": "en", "ref": "Targum Jonathan on Numbers 12:3", "heRef": "תרגום יונתן על במדבר י״ב:ג׳", "url": "Targum_Jonathan_on_Numbers.12.3"}, "Daniel.12.9": {"he": "וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל כִּֽי־סְתֻמִ֧ים וַחֲתֻמִ֛ים הַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַד־עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ׃", "en": "He said, “Go, Daniel, for these words are secret and sealed to the time of the end. ", "lang": "en", "ref": "Daniel 12:9", "heRef": "דניאל י״ב:ט׳", "url": "Daniel.12.9"}, "Pirkei_Avot.4.15": {"he": "רַבִּי יַנַּאי אוֹמֵר, אֵין בְּיָדֵינוּ לֹא מִשַּׁלְוַת הָרְשָׁעִים וְאַף לֹא מִיִּסּוּרֵי הַצַּדִּיקִים. רַבִּי מַתְיָא בֶן חָרָשׁ אוֹמֵר, הֱוֵי מַקְדִּים בִּשְׁלוֹם כָּל אָדָם. וֶהֱוֵי זָנָב לָאֲרָיוֹת, וְאַל תְּהִי רֹאשׁ לַשּׁוּעָלִים: \n", "en": "Rabbi Yannai said: it is not in our hands [to explain the reason] either of the security of the wicked, or even of the afflictions of the righteous. Rabbi Mathia ben Harash said: Upon meeting people, be the first to extend greetings; And be a tail unto lions, and not a head unto foxes.", "lang": "en", "ref": "Pirkei Avot 4:15", "heRef": "משנה אבות ד׳:ט״ו", "url": "Pirkei_Avot.4.15"}}
